motion_rule: a full sprint from the first frame, the camera racing backwards ahead of him so the walls tear past every beat and his face stays to the lens; his head fills half the frame, head-on and closer from 6.8; new shot size each beat; camera move every beat
character: a rangy grey wolf in a cheap frayed office jacket, yellow eyes, teeth bared
second_characters: A SWARM of pale office ghosts bursting out of every drawer along both walls from 5.9, jabbing a finger at him and cackling as he runs
props: ONE translucent glowing pay envelope flying at his nose height, nothing printed on it
prop_continuity: the envelope stays translucent and glowing all clip, is never held, and nothing ever touches it solidly
environment: a long office corridor, grey pay windows and filing drawers both sides to the ceiling, hard noon sun through the skylights
light_events: skylight bars strobe his face every beat, cold rim both sides, the envelope flares at 9.5

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.0 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pacing: 0.0-2.4, 3.4-5.9, 6.8-9.0 three breaths, every gap under one second; he says each line once and never says a line twice; after 9.0 not a word
audio.lip_sync: his jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: claws hammering the floor all clip, drawers banging open along both walls from 5.9, a hollow shimmer whenever his teeth pass through the envelope, a ghost crowd cackling from 5.9 to the end, never words

timeline.a: the frame opens tight on his jaws snapping shut on the glowing envelope and closing straight through it, already at a full sprint
he swipes a paw at the envelope and it slips through his claws, and he digs harder, the walls streaking
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide, and drops back into the corridor still driving hard
he drives head on at the lens, pay windows tearing past both sides
his jaws snap at the envelope twice at full drive and close through it both times
every drawer along both walls bangs open at once and the ghosts pour out over him, paper blowing apart
the ghosts stream alongside him jabbing a finger at him, and he shoulders through them still driving
the envelope cuts sideways, he slams after it through the ghost crowd, shoulder raking the drawers
the whole crowd swings round on him at once, arms out, every finger on him, cackling
he throws himself into the lens, jaws wide, the envelope hanging whole and glowing inside them, the ghosts pointing past both walls

must_appear: at 5.9 every drawer along both walls bangs open and the ghosts pour out; from 6.8 they run alongside him jabbing a finger at him and cackling; at 9.0 the whole crowd swings round and points at him at once; at 9.5 he throws himself into the lens with his jaws wide and the envelope hangs whole and glowing inside them
negative_prompt: speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a line said twice, a word not in the lines, a drawn-out word, ghosts speaking words, a solid opaque envelope, teeth denting the envelope, a parked camera, a still background, a stopped hero, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a hero moving away from the lens, a held pose, slow motion, cyrillic letters, readable text, human hands, extra limbs
